import json, subprocess, sys
def run(doc):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/main.py"],
                       input=json.dumps(doc).encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    if p.stdout.startswith(b'{"error"'):
        return None, p.stdout
    return json.loads(p.stdout), p.stderr

def cfg(**kw):
    c = {"slots": 1, "window": 1, "idle_timeout": 1000, "len_quantum": 1, "gap_quantum": 1,
         "rate_num": 1, "rate_den": 1, "bucket_capacity": 512, "initial_tokens": 512,
         "pending_capacity": 512, "lanes": 1, "service": [1], "fallback": 0,
         "time_edges": [0], "count_edges": [0], "probability": [[65536]]}
    c.update(kw); return c

def model(shift=0, bias=0, w=1, C=2, dense=None, dbias=None, K=1, E=1):
    return {"classes": C, "embedding_dim": E,
            "length_embedding": [[a] for a in range(16)],
            "gap_embedding": [[0] for _ in range(16)],
            "kernel": K, "conv_weights": [[[w, 0]]] if K == 1 else [[[w, 0], [0, 0]]],
            "conv_bias": [bias], "conv_shift": [shift],
            "dense_weights": dense if dense is not None else [[0], [1]],
            "dense_bias": dbias if dbias is not None else [0, 0]}

# --- rounding ties away from zero, saturation
cases = [(5, 0, 0, 5), (5, 1, 0, 3), (3, 1, 0, 2), (2, 1, 0, 1), (7, 1, 0, 4),
         (1, 1, 0, 1), (1000, 0, 0, 127), (200, 0, 0, 127), (255, 1, 0, 127),
         (0, 0, -3, 0), (4, 0, -10, 0), (300, 2, 0, 75), (301, 2, 0, 75), (302, 2, 0, 76)]
ok = True
for length, shift, bias, expect in cases:
    m = model(shift=shift, bias=bias)
    if length > 15:
        # use len_quantum 1 but saturate bin at 15 -> emulate large z via bias
        m = model(shift=shift, bias=bias + length - 15)
        length = 15
    doc = {"version": 1, "config": cfg(service=[1, 1]), "model": m,
           "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
           "packets": [{"time": 0, "connection": "a", "length": length, "draw": 0}]}
    out, err = run(doc)
    got = out["jobs"][0]["logits"][1]
    flag = "ok" if got == expect else "FAIL"
    if got != expect: ok = False
    print(" z-case len=%s shift=%d bias=%d -> logits[1]=%s expect %s %s" % (length, shift, m["conv_bias"][0], got, expect, flag))
print("rounding all ok:", ok)

# --- count_edges bins with growing backlog
docI = {"version": 1,
        "config": cfg(count_edges=[0, 2, 4], probability=[[0, 65536, 65536]], service=[1, 1]),
        "model": model(),
        "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
        "packets": [{"time": t, "connection": "a", "length": 10, "draw": 0} for t in range(6)]}
out, err = run(docI)
print("I decisions:", [p["decision"] for p in out["packets"]], "expect probability,sent,probability,sent,...")

# backlog beyond final edge
docI2 = {"version": 1,
         "config": cfg(count_edges=[0, 2], probability=[[0, 0]], service=[1, 1]),
         "model": model(),
         "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
         "packets": [{"time": t, "connection": "a", "length": 10, "draw": 0} for t in range(4)]}
out, err = run(docI2)
print("I2 decisions:", [p["decision"] for p in out["packets"]], "expect all probability")

# time_edges bins: exports blocked -> Ti grows
docI3 = {"version": 1,
         "config": cfg(time_edges=[0, 3, 6], count_edges=[0], probability=[[0], [0], [65536]], service=[1, 1]),
         "model": model(),
         "connections": [{"id": "a", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"}],
         "packets": [{"time": t, "connection": "a", "length": 10, "draw": 0} for t in range(9)]}
out, err = run(docI3)
print("I3 decisions:", [p["decision"] for p in out["packets"]], "expect first sent? anchor=0 -> Ti=t")

# --- macro_f1 rational reduction, C=3
docR = {"version": 1,
        "config": cfg(service=[1, 1, 1]),
        "model": model(C=3, dense=[[0], [1], [-1]], dbias=[0, 0, 0]),
        "connections": [{"id": "c0", "slot": 0, "label": 0, "split": "dev"},
                        {"id": "c1", "slot": 0, "label": 1, "split": "dev"},
                        {"id": "c2", "slot": 0, "label": 2, "split": "dev"}],
        "packets": [{"time": 0, "connection": "c0", "length": 5, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 1, "connection": "c1", "length": 5, "draw": 0},
                    {"time": 2, "connection": "c2", "length": 5, "draw": 0}]}
out, err = run(docR)
print("R conns:", [(c["id"], c["votes"], c["prediction"]) for c in out["connections"]])
print("R dev:", json.dumps(out["reports"]["dev"]), "expect confusion col1 rows, macro_f1 [2,9]")
